provenance.operatorDescription: Drives RegisterFragmentService.getHearingDate down each of its four uncovered legs.
provenance.operatorRationale: Defect row C35. getHearingDate (RegisterFragmentService.js:46-55) has two legs that end at `dateService.getLocalDateTime(undefined)`, and `moment.tz(undefined, zone)` is the CURRENT TIME — so `hearingDate`, a value progression stores and prints, is whenever the function app happened to run, and two replays of one hearing produce two different registers. It also has two legs that THROW. Every base hearing carries an orderedDate and an empty hearingDays, which is the one path through the function that is neither, so the corpus as first recorded never touched the row. The two clock legs are recorded as clock-dependent and carry an alternate-clock golden, which is the harness saying in data what the row says in prose: there is no oracle in a clock reading. The two throwing legs are deterministic, and they are the row's other half — the legacy loses the hearing to a swallowed TypeError where the port raises a classified failure.

operatorDetail.why: C35's first throwing leg — `if (hearingObj.hearingDays)` is a truthiness test, so an object passes it and `.find` is not a function. The legacy loses the whole hearing to a swallowed TypeError; the port classifies
